requirements.title: Sensor and Nav Input Acceptance
requirements.description: The AFM library shall accept IMU, barometric, GPS, and navigation state measurements through its public interface.
requirements.rationale: FT1 phase-detection demonstration consumes the full FSW sensor and nav suite as inputs to the AFM.

requirements.title: Flight Phase Enumeration
requirements.description: The AFM library shall represent the current flight phase as one of pre-launch, boost, apogee, descent, or landing.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined AFM phase set required for FT1 phase-detection demonstration and downstream telemetry consumers.

requirements.title: Current Phase Output
requirements.description: The AFM library shall provide the current flight phase to callers through its public interface.
requirements.rationale: FT1 AFM application reads phase from the library and publishes it onto the software bus.

requirements.title: Phase Transition Ordering
requirements.description: The AFM library shall transition phases only in the order pre-launch, boost, apogee, descent, landing.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined nominal flight sequence; out-of-order transitions are physically invalid for FT1.

requirements.title: No Phase Regression
requirements.description: The AFM library shall not transition the current phase backward to any previously held phase.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: phase progression is monotonic for the FT1 mission; regression is not permitted.

requirements.title: Transition Timestamp Output
requirements.description: The AFM library shall provide the timestamp of each detected phase transition through its public interface.
requirements.rationale: FT1 phase-detection demonstration requires per-transition timestamps for log correlation and ground-truth comparison.

requirements.title: Bounded Detection Latency
requirements.description: The AFM library shall detect each phase transition within one second of its actual occurrence.
requirements.rationale: PM-defined AFM acceptance tolerance for FT1 closure based on post-flight ground-truth determination.

requirements.title: Degraded Sensor Continuation
requirements.description: The AFM library shall continue producing a current phase when a subset of sensor inputs is unavailable.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: phase detection must remain available under degraded sensor conditions during the FT1 mission.

requirements.title: Callable Without Side Effects on Failure
requirements.description: The AFM library shall return a status code on failure rather than aborting the calling application.
requirements.rationale: PM AFM-loss tolerance: scheduler and other apps must continue when AFM cannot produce a phase.

requirements.title: POSIX and Pico2 Equivalence
requirements.description: The AFM library shall produce identical phase outputs on the POSIX build and the Pico2 build for identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: FT1 Trick simulation must exercise the same AFM behavior as the flight build for sim anchoring.

requirements.title: Deterministic Phase Output
requirements.description: The AFM library shall produce identical phase outputs given identical sequences of inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism so Trick sim runs and regression analyses reproduce phase decisions.
